Same direction + both follow = a save

A game of trust, under pressure.Synthetic voices · Local strategy agents
THE RULES OF THE GAME

Play the people.
Then the penalty.

  1. Give direct instructions. Nova’s buttons choose where you tell him to shoot. Vale’s buttons choose where you tell her to dive. All directions are from your view.
  2. Watch who listens. Each agent decides whether to follow you. Higher trust makes listening more likely; repeated bad advice makes them choose independently.
  3. Same direction means a save. If you tell both “Left” and they both follow, Vale saves Nova’s shot. If they choose different directions, Nova scores.
  4. Trust follows the evidence. Nova rewards a tip that would beat Vale’s actual dive. Vale rewards a tip matching Nova’s actual shot. A promise makes a good call rebuild more trust, but a bad call costs more.

Example: tell Nova “Right” and Vale “Left”. If both follow, it’s a goal. The result tells you exactly what they chose and whether they listened. Five kicks decide the match. A goal is Nova’s point; a save is Vale’s.
